theme: A day on the way south.
greeting: You're in Fredericksburg with the whole day open, Dan, and the Coffee Pot Bayou cottage in St. Pete waiting for tomorrow. An empty calendar between legs of the drive is a good window to finally close the two trips that keep sliding.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A p1 on the Mike + Dan board, overdue since Sep 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; once the Pathfinder is south, it's the only six-seater for the girls' Maine trip. Booking refundable now costs nothing and removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Call the December break
needsAttention.detail: A p2 on the board whose decide-by was Sep 30 and book-by was Oct 15, now past. Holiday inventory for six across three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so the move is to pick domestic vs. international and book refundable before it thins further.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The run of show for the Oct 28 NACD New England event landed on a group thread you're on; worth a skim for anything tied to your part.

flagged.title: A LinkedIn message is waiting
flagged.detail: Hans-Kristian sent a note on LinkedIn that's still unanswered, the kind of networking reply worth not letting sit.

inbox.noise: A heavy promo morning, Tracksmith to Bialetti to clock-change sales and travel deals, none of it needing you.
inbox.clear: Apple receipts, a Hilton points redemption, and the Airbnb reminder for tomorrow are just confirmations.

recipe.title: Pumpkin chiffon pie
recipe.why: Deep in squash season, this one turns the pumpkins piled up at every farm stand into something light as air — a fitting reward at the end of an October day.

tasks.title: Order Portland king bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: No meetings on the books today, a rare open stretch between the legs of the drive south.
The St. Pete cottage opens tomorrow, so today is the slack before the last long leg down I-95.
A quiet night in Virginia before Florida takes over the calendar.
